reason: Alert 2 (java/sql-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink value is attacker-controlled. User input flows from Cookie -> param -> doSomething(Map.put('keyB-36088', param)) -> Map.get('keyB-36088') -> bar -> sql. The Map key is constant, but the value retrieved equals the user input 'param'. This allows SQL injection into the query string. Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-FP — resolved sink value is sanitized. While 'sql' contains user input, the sink expression calls ESAPI.encoder().encodeForHTML(sql) before printing to the HTML response, neutralizing the XSS risk on this specific path.
